title: kobresia royleana var. paniculata
intro: Kobresia royleana var. paniculata, commonly known as Tufted Club-sedge or Tufted Cattail Sedge, is a type of sedge plant in the family Cyperaceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include its ability to treat various health conditions such as fever, rheumatism, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Kobresia royleana var. paniculata include its anti-inflammatory, antipyretic, and expectorant properties, which help to reduce inflammation, lower fever, and relieve respiratory congestion. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and health benefits.
